subject: Wow, You're Rich!
text: The Wow, You're Rich! achievement requires holding 50,000 GP at one time.

evidence.quote: $50,000 at one time, but if you plan on getting the level 50 achievement, you should naturally get this or at least be very close even if you buy all the equipment throughout the game.

subject: Were Axe
text: The Were Axe is in Davias' Mansion, beyond a room where a door switch must be activated with a snowman.

evidence.quote: Located in Davias' Mansion. beyond a room that requires you to activate a door switch with a snowman.

subject: Blood Sword

evidence.quote: In Glaive Castle, sometime after the Chimera boss.

subject: Blood Sword

subject: Samurai Armor and Helm
text: If an enemy loots a chest while your inventory is full, examine the chest until you gain the armor and helmet.

evidence.quote: when an ennemy loots a chest, if your inventory is full, examine the chest until gain the armor and the helmet.

subject: Samurai Armor and Helm
text: Respawn the room until two enemies remain, then leave and re-enter after killing one to reset it.

evidence.quote: you can respawn the room until there's 2 enemies. Then leave and come back when you kill one, and it resets.

subject: Samurai Armor
text: Kill the ninjas in one room, save, soft reset, and load to respawn new ninjas for farming.

evidence.quote: 1. Go to a room with ninjas. Kill them. Save. Soft reset the game, load, and a new set of ninjas will spawn.

subject: Samurai Helm
text: Kill the Demon Heads with the Nuke spell, then save and use Ethers and Elixirs to restore MP and repeat.

evidence.quote: kill the demons with the Nuke spell. Save and use up whatever Ethers and Elixirs on hand to get your MP back.

subject: Samurai Armor and Helm
text: Leaving one enemy alive, then leaving and re-entering the room, works without a soft reset.

evidence.quote: It works better if you just leave one enemy alive and go back out and come back in.
